第474章 剪刀听见了名字（第1页）
剪刀听见了名字（剪刀听见了名字（第22页）像有人在学他的心跳。三、不是敲门，是学他剪刀在瓷砖上轻轻跳动。不是有人碰它——是剪刀自己在动。刃尖敲击地面，发出细小的声响。一下，两下，三下。节奏和陈默右肩焦痕一模一样。陈默盯着那把剪刀。金属反光里，他看见的不是自己的脸，而是一扇门——手术室的门，门缝里透出暗红色的光，和黑线白纹里的光影一模一样。剪刀继续敲。咚。咚。咚。不是门后的敲击，是剪刀在瓷砖上敲出来的。节奏越来越快，越来越密，像有人在用刀尖写字。陈默蹲下来，盯着剪刀的刃尖。刃尖在地砖上划出两道痕迹——不是裂纹，是像墨水一样的黑色印记，在白色瓷砖上格外刺眼。两道痕迹交叉，形成一个字。雷。第二笔还没写完，刃尖自己转了方向，开始写第二个字。陈。陈默右肩焦痕猛跳一下。他看见剪刀的刃尖不是被什么东西操控——是剪刀自己在写。金属表面那层雾气重新出现，不是从黑线里渗出来的，是从剪刀内部往外渗，像刀身自己在出汗。第三个字刚写了一半，陈默伸手按住了剪刀。不是抓——是用掌心压住刃口。金属冰凉，冰到骨头里，像握住一块刚从冰水里捞出来的铁片。但陈默没松手，他把自己的频率压进剪刀——右肩焦痕的跳动，从掌心灌进刀身。剪刀停止敲击。但门后的敲击没有停。咚。咚。咚。三声之后，焦痕里传来一句话。不是中文，不是英文，是一种陈默从未听过的语言——但每个字都像烙铁一样烫进他的意识里：“你握着它，它就能切开。”“切开门。”“然后你就能看见你自己。”陈默没有动。他低头看手里的剪刀。金属表面那层白霜在融化，水滴顺着刃口滑落，滴在地砖上。水滴落地时发出细小的声响——咚、咚、咚，三个音节。雷。诺。陈。默。陈默抬起头，看着手术室的门。门缝里的光更亮了，亮到能看清门板上的木纹，每一条纹路都在流动，像血管。门后传来一个声音。不是敲门。不是脚步声。是一句话——“进来，雷诺。”“进来看看，你是谁。”陈默握着剪刀的手在抖。不是怕——是右肩焦痕在跳，跳得整条手臂都在震。剪刀的刃尖在空气中轻轻晃动，每一次晃动，门缝里的光就亮一分。医护的声音从身后传来：“陈默……你……你的肩膀……”陈默没回头。但他知道医护看见了什么——右肩焦痕在发光。不是红色，不是白色，是一种暗金色的光，从皮肤下面渗出来，像有一团火在他的骨头里燃烧。门缝里的光也在燃烧。两种光，隔着门，隔着门缝，隔着三根已经缩回去的黑线，在空气中轻轻触碰。陈默的手指收紧。剪刀的刃口，对准了门缝。李主任掌心的第三只手突然翻掌——不是挣扎，不是求救，是把掌纹对准了陈默的右肩。掌纹里浮出一只细小的眼。不是画上去的，是皮肤自己裂开，露出底下的瞳孔。那只眼没有看李主任。没有看医生。它看着陈默右肩焦痕里的暗金色光，瞳孔慢慢收缩，像在读取什么东西。陈默听见自己的心跳从胸口传到了门后。咚。咚。咚。门后的敲击停了下来。然后，一个声音从门缝里渗出来——不是从外面传进来的，是从门缝本身渗出来的，像木头在呼吸：“雷诺。”“你终于听见了。”

Chapter 474 Scissors heard the name (Page 1)
Scissors heard the name (Scissors heard the name (page 22)) as if someone was imitating his heartbeat. 3. It was not knocking on the door, but imitating him. The scissors beat lightly on the tiles. It was not someone touching it - the scissors were moving by themselves. The tip of the blade hit the ground, making a small sound. Once, twice, three times. The rhythm was exactly the same as the scorch marks on Chen Mo's right shoulder. Chen Mo stared at the scissors. In the metal reflection, what he saw was not his own face, but a door. ——The dark red light shines from the cracks in the door, which is exactly the same as the light and shadow in the black lines and white lines. The scissors continue to knock. It’s not the knocking on the door, but the rhythm of the scissors on the tiles. It was getting faster and denser, as if someone was writing with the tip of a knife. Chen Mo squatted down and stared at the tip of the scissors. The tip of the scissors made two marks on the floor tiles - not cracks, but black marks like ink on the white tiles. It was particularly dazzling. The two traces intersected to form a word. "Lei". Before the second stroke was finished, the tip of the blade turned around and started to write the second word. Chen Mo's right shoulder was not touched by anything. The fog on the metal surface reappeared, not from the black line, but from the inside of the scissors, as if the third word was being written. Chen Mo reached out and held down the scissors. He didn't hold it - he pressed the blade with his palm. The metal was cold to the bone, like holding a piece of iron just fished out of ice water. But Chen Mo didn't let go. He pressed his own frequency into the scissors. The scorch mark on the right shoulder penetrated the blade. But the knocking on the door did not stop. After three sounds, a word came from the scorch mark. A language that Chen Mo had never heard before - but every word was burned into his consciousness like a soldering iron: "You hold it, and it can cut." "Cut the door." "Then you can see yourself." Chen Mo did not move. Look down at the scissors in your hand. The white frost on the metal surface is melting, and the water drops are falling on the floor. There are three syllables. Chen Mo raised his head and looked at the door of the operating room. The light in the door was brighter, and every line on the door panel was flowing, like a blood vessel. There was a sound from behind the door. It was not a knock. It was a word - "Come in, Renault." "Come in and see who you are." It wasn't because the hand holding the scissors was shaking, and the tip of the scissors was shaking in the air. Shaking slightly, the light in the crack of the door became brighter. The doctor's voice came from behind: "Chen Mo... you... your shoulder..." Chen Mo didn't turn around. But he knew what the doctor saw - the burn mark on his right shoulder was glowing. It was not red, not white, but a dark golden light, seeping out from under the skin, like a fire burning in his bones. The light in the crack of the door was also burning.隔着三根已经缩回去的黑线，在空气中轻轻触碰。陈默的手指收紧。剪刀的刃口，对准了门缝。李主任掌心的第三只手突然翻掌——不是挣扎，不是求救，是把掌纹对准了陈默的右肩。掌纹里浮出一只细小的眼。不是画上去的，是皮肤自己裂开，露出底下的瞳孔。那只眼没有看李主任。没有看医生。它看着陈默右The dark golden light in the shoulder marks, the pupils slowly contracted, as if they were reading something. Chen Mo heard his heartbeat from his chest to the back of the door. Boom. Boom. Boom. The knocking on the back of the door stopped. Then, a voice seeped out from the crack in the door—not from the outside, but from the crack itself, like wood breathing: "Reno." "You finally heard it."
